requirements.text: The lead coordinates, scopes and reviews; each substantive tracked task has one assigned worker.
Create each issue in Backlog, explicitly enqueue it as Todo, and confirm the worker before In Progress.
Attempts, startup, process identity, liveness and progress have distinct durable records; no fabricated Running state.
All task reads, events and mutations are scoped to authenticated principal, project and logical session.
Each independent task owns its worktree and application database today; control metadata is separate.
Admission atomically claims tasks and finite host, project and resource capacity; no overload or double claim.
Dependencies, human holds, priority and approved queue membership determine eligibility.

Build a standalone merge engine in focused domains through its own implemented API/CLI contract. Retire merge-to-dev.sh and every compatibility wrapper or alias for that entrypoint. Workers commit in their own worktrees; one authority validates and integrates into the trusted configured target. Critically audit source/history scenarios, version retained/corrected outcomes, verify checks, resource lifetime, concurrency, recovery and performance in independently authored projects, and preserve all historical failures.

Code normally follows In Progress → In Dev → In Staging → Done with verified delivery evidence. In Review may exit directly to any configured status with destination-specific evidence. No work starts on delivered issues.
Linear sync uses durable outbound operations, deduplication, readback and reconciliation of uncertain writes.
Backlog is not automatic admission; the model cannot create work or claim arbitrary backlog to fill slots.
Human status, assignment, acceptance and hold decisions remain authoritative and attributed.

Cancel, duplicate, deletion and non-code completion use explicit allowed causes and evidence. In Review can move to every configured status, with an authorized decision and destination-specific guards.
Crash, timeout, retry, cancellation and unknown state recover without competing attempts or lost work.
CLI, MCP, hooks and presentation use one application API and one transition policy.
Both installed Claude Code and installed Codex CLI integrations execute real acceptance cases.
The companion pane groups own-session tasks by status, expands descriptions and supports keyboard and plain output.
Versioned GitHub distribution supports install, update, disable, uninstall and retained state.
Future parent/resource ownership is representable; shared application databases are not enabled today.

The authorized build has no total spending, elapsed-time or retry ceiling under the recorded later user instruction. Preserve original run identity, accounting and failures; enforce finite measured capacity, reviewed batches, per-invocation deadlines and bounded charge reservations.
Every workflow has reviewed mechanical tests and fresh behavioral evidence; replay is separate.

Acceptance requires at least two selected non-Fable models on each actual installed CLI, with separate source/host/model/effort/OS result cells. Retain every failed attempt and reject substitutions or mixed-profile aggregation.
Live integration uses actual TST fixtures, real readback and only run-owned cleanup; two-user identity is verified.

The product installs and works in empty and unrelated projects using its own domains and trusted configuration, with no AI Index runtime dependency or legacy catalog translation. AI Index scripts and copies must not live anywhere in the product repository, including ignored caches, worktrees, examples or fixtures. Inspect originals read-only; keep required immutable historical source evidence outside the product with hashes/relocation records and no import or symlink bridge. Expose no personal names or credentials in Markdown.
Reproducible builds, structured diagnostics, test reports and immutable result records support release decisions.
The fresh builder has bounded phases, tracked work, durable checkpoints, recovery and a truthful terminal report.
Authenticate operations, validate paths and command arguments, redact secrets and test all supported bypass surfaces.

After standalone product completion and a later user-requested target audit, inventory all then-current files, Markdown and callers before one clean cutover. Remove fully superseded files and only overlapping parts of mixed files, preserving unrelated behavior and history. Report what the script handles and what the user must change; deliver tested docs/migrate.md commands/recovery. Verify generic installation/migration independently, without retaining old application scripts.
Any failed, blocked or unrun required case prevents accepted release; coverage is reported by layer and profile.
Partial work, multiple attempts, reopened requests and follow-up issues preserve task and delivery distinctions.
Resource stop/removal is owned, idempotent and compatible with merges; orphan recovery never removes foreign resources.

Retain the separately requested purposes of #push, #release, #hotfix and /sync-with-dev through appropriate new integration contracts; do not preserve retired script-based routing or an alias for merge-to-dev.sh. Test deployment effects only with isolated fixtures.

The product owns concise necessary instructions and generated transition references over the executable engine. Remove obsolete instructions; an old task-management filename or path is not a required survivor. Add new product-owned guidance only where actual consumers need it, and verify parity with executable rules.
Old writers are fenced off before new admission; rollback never enables two live authorities or loses post-cutover facts.
Local incidents and user feedback feed a bounded opt-in repair, regression, verified release and safe update/rollback loop; private evidence is not uploaded without authorization.

The full user request → reviewed task prose → Linear Backlog → scoped CLI linkage → Todo → confirmed worker/In Progress → verified result → CLI/Linear settlement → lead AI acknowledgement → user report is observable and recoverable.
Linear and local tasks synchronize through immediate durable outbound events and authenticated inbound webhooks; reconciliation polling is recovery only; CLI and lead receive scoped real-time events.

Every new or updated task prose uses Technical Writer, the appropriate issue-type reference and Writing Style; exact content/version approval precedes publication; skill updates trigger scoped audits and retained evidence.
